script: Everyone says this tortoise met Charles Darwin. She probably never did. Harriet lived at Steve Irwin's zoo, and for decades her story was that Darwin personally collected her from the Galapagos in 1835. But DNA testing found she came from an island Darwin never actually visited - so most researchers now doubt he ever touched her shell. She still lived to 175 either way - longer than the myth about her. Follow for more true stories with a twist nobody expects.

metadata.title: Random But True: The Darwin Tortoise Myth That's Probably False
metadata.caption:
Harriet lived most of her life at Steve Irwin's Australia Zoo. For decades, her story was that Charles Darwin personally collected her from the Galapagos in 1835.

DNA testing found she's actually from Santa Cruz Island - a Galapagos island Darwin's own travel records show he never visited.

Most researchers now doubt he ever collected her, even though the zoo still tells the traditional story.

She died in 2006 at about 175 years old, having carried that Darwin story for most of her life - even though it's probably not true.
